content.text:
Found it.

## Cause

Commit `fc103ace03` ("integrate Shortcut for the new pharmacy") changed how a shortcut resolves its target in [keyboardShortcutUtils.ts](src/Utils/keyboardShortcutUtils.ts):

**Before** — it clicked the badge element itself, no matter where it was or whether it was visible:
```ts
document.querySelector(`[data-shortcut-id='${shortcutId}']`).click();
```

**After** — it walks up to the enclosing button/link and requires it to be *rendered*:
```ts
if (!host.isConnected || host.getClientRects().length === 0) return false;
```

`pin-page`'s trigger in [PinPageDialog.tsx](src/components/Common/PinPageDialog.tsx#L88-L94) is a `Button` with `className="hidden"` → `display:none` → zero client rects → `resolveInteractiveHosts` drops it → `resolveBestHost` returns `undefined` → shift+B silently does nothing.

The `issue-invoice` badge you cited works because its `ShortcutBadge` sits inside a **visible** `Button` in [InvoiceShow.tsx](src/pages/Facility/billing/invoice/InvoiceShow.tsx#L430-L438), so the host survives the new filter.

Secondary trap in the same commit: `resolveBestHost` returns `undefined` whenever *any* `[role='dialog']` is mounted and the host isn't inside an open overlay — so even a visible trigger won't fire while a dialog is on screen.

## Fix

Keep the trigger rendered but visually hidden, so it still has layout boxes:

Audited all 100-odd shortcut call sites against the resolver rules. Findings, grouped by severity:

## 1. Same bug class as `pin-page` (host is `display:none`)
None left. `PinPageDialog` was the only unconditionally-`hidden` host; every other `hidden` is responsive (`hidden sm:flex`) with a visible counterpart.

## 2. Context clobbering — badge never registers
[ChargeItemsTable.tsx](src/pages/Facility/billing/account/components/ChargeItemsTable.tsx#L134) calls `useShortcutSubContext("facility:billing")`, but it renders inside [AccountShow.tsx](src/pages/Facility/billing/account/AccountShow.tsx#L316), which sets `"facility:account:show"`. Child effects run before parent effects, so the parent wins — `facility:billing` is never in the active hierarchy there. Result: the `add-charge-item` badge at [ChargeItemsTable.tsx](src/pages/Facility/billing/account/components/ChargeItemsTable.tsx#L384) renders blank *and* `A` does nothing on the account page.

Fix: add `{ "key": "a", "action": "add-charge-item" }` to `facility:account:show`, or drop the child's `useShortcutSubContext` call.

## 3. Key shadowing by a dead action
`facility:patient:home` binds `p` → `print-token`, which has **no badge anywhere in src/**. Because `direct[key]` is overwritten in context order (global → … → most specific), this shadows the global `p` → `print-button` on Patient Home. Pressing `P` there is a no-op.

## 4. Config entries that can never fire
- `facility:pharmacy:supply-delivery` (lines 73–77): no component ever sets this sub-context, so `mark-as-received`, `proceed-without-marking`, `proceed-with-marking` are all dead.
- `facility:general` (line 29): never set; its `print-button` override is a dead duplicate of the global one.
- `facility:patient` → `patient-home` (`h`): no badge in src/.
- `facility:billing:invoice` → `view-invoice-payment` (`v`): no badge in src/.

## 5. Badge with no interactive host
[SearchInput.tsx](src/components/Common/SearchInput.tsx#L65) puts `search-input-shortcut` on a `<div>` with no `button`/`a`/`[role=button]` ancestor, so `resolveInteractiveHosts` finds nothing and `⌘K` never fires. This one also wouldn't have worked pre-regression (clicking a div can't focus an input) — it needs either `data-shortcut-target` on a real host plus a focus handler, or a dedicated handler instead of the click-dispatch path.

## 6. Overflowed tabs lose their shortcuts
[nav-tabs.tsx](src/components/ui/nav-tabs.tsx#L140-L151) renders overflow tabs as `DropdownMenuItem` with the label only — no `ShortcutBadge`. So at narrow breakpoints the `g c` / `g v` / `g n` encounter tabs and `shift+5` on AccountShow have no DOM node and silently do nothing. Pre-existing, breakpoint-dependent.

Also worth noting as a latent trap from the same commit: `resolveBestHost` returns `undefined` whenever *any* `[role='dialog']`/`[role='alertdialog']` is mounted and the target isn't inside an open overlay — so any future always-mounted dialog will globally disable page-level shortcuts.

Items 2, 3 and 4 are config-level one-liners but encode product intent (which keys you actually want bound). Tell me which to apply and I'll make the edits.
